source.name: U.S. Sassuolo Calcio: Puma e US Sassuolo Calcio presentano il nuovo Home Kit 26/27
source.quote: Il look è completato dal logo del Sassuolo nella sua versione full color con bordo grigio e dai loghi PUMA e MAPEI in Puma White a contrasto.
source.note: Translation: 'The look is completed by the Sassuolo crest in its full-colour version with a grey border and by the PUMA and MAPEI logos in contrasting Puma White.' The launch text lists only the crest and the PUMA and MAPEI logos as completing the shirt's look; Calcio e Finanza (see deal sassuolo-mapei-front) reports Mapei as the main shirt sponsor.

source.name: U.S. Sassuolo Calcio: Puma e US Sassuolo Calcio presentano il nuovo Home Kit 26/27
source.quote: PUMA e U.S. Sassuolo Calcio presentano oggi il nuovo Home Kit che accompagnerà le squadre maschili, femminili e giovanili nella stagione sportiva 2026/2027.
source.note: Translation: 'PUMA and U.S. Sassuolo Calcio today unveil the new Home Kit that the men's, women's and youth teams will wear in the 2026/2027 season.' The page describes the kit's PUMA dryCELL technology and RE:FIBRE construction, i.e. PUMA is the kit manufacturer.

summary: Mapei on the front; Puma is the kit manufacturer. The club's launch text lists only the crest and the PUMA and MAPEI logos on the shirt.
